## Activity

Market Eye Clinic recorded 446 captures during June 2026. Activity was maintained across the reporting period, and session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity records indicate that scheduled image capture proceeded without other reported disruption.

## Image quality

There were 93 ungradable captures, giving an ungradable rate of 20.9. This represents the proportion of captures that could not be assessed to the required standard. The result should be considered alongside local operating arrangements and the practical conditions under which images were obtained.

## Grading

Grading identified 100 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 2 days. This provides the central measure of time from image capture to completion of grading for the month. Overall, the site’s activity, image quality, and grading measures are recorded for routine monitoring and follow-up through the usual operational processes.
